findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: the hero <svg> is aria-hidden="true"; the <figcaption> reads only 'Example: a Computer Science graduate looking for work in Poland.' The three outcomes drawn in the svg ('Data Analyst 87% match', 'BI Developer 80% match', 'Product Analyst 74% match') are hidden from assistive technology.
findings.after:
Add a visually hidden list inside the figure:
  • Data Analyst, 87% match
  • BI Developer, 80% match
  • Product Analyst, 74% match
, or extend the figcaption
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: the image carries the page's main example and its text equivalent omits it.

findings.where: skip link 'Skip to main content' (focus stop 0)
findings.evidence: focus.json stop 0 has covered=true: the skip link appears at y 16 under the sticky header (confirms sweep focus_ring hit). It is the right first stop but is obscured when it shows.
findings.before: Skip link positioned under the sticky header
findings.after: .skip-link:focus { position: fixed; top: 8px; left: 8px; z-index: 100 } (above the header's z-index)

findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: 'About' and 'Legal' are <button>s with chevrons (dropdowns) while 'Home' and 'Help / Contact' are links; no aria-expanded is recorded for the dropdown buttons in the capture.
findings.after: <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="about-menu">About</button> and toggle aria-expanded on open
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: disclosure state must be exposed. Not verified live; flagged from the DOM.

findings.evidence: Sweep ROB-001: 100% of text is invisible with JavaScript off; manifest also lists the React, motion and Supabase bundles. Confirms the page is client-rendered only (noted, not repeated as a new sweep hit).
findings.after: Pre-render the marketing page (static HTML) so content exists before hydration
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 / robustness: assistive tech and low-power devices that fail to run the bundle get an empty page.
